title: Acting beats? Perfect! Obsession with heteronormativity? Less than #r...
transcript: I just got back from the Colorado Springs Philharmonic. They did an entire night of Rogers and hammerstein's music, and it was absolutely glorious. Hammerstein, like, truly changed musical theater for the better. They wrote some of the most gorgeous pieces in musical theater canon. Even just the Carousel. Walt is a perfect piece of music, but every time I hear Soliloquy, I can't help but think, this is gorgeous music. But if Billy Bigelow wasn't so obsessed with the gender of his child, he'd probably be alive at the end of the show to see her grow up. Anyway, does anybody wanna rewrite the lyrics of that song? I don't know. I think it'd be a fun exercise.
classificationReason: Commentary about a concert performance of Rodgers and Hammerstein music by Colorado Springs Philharmonic, not a stage production from the list
